lines.zh: 我张开鞘翅，从林间飞过。
lines.en: I open my wing cases and fly between the trees.

lines.zh: 我的身体比一头牛还大。
lines.en: My body is larger than an ox.
I pass beneath the canopy.

lines.zh: 我的大颚在前面，分开枝叶。
lines.en: My mandibles part the branches ahead.

lines.zh: 我飞着，六条腿垂在身下。
lines.en: I fly with six legs hanging beneath me.
I settle on a thick branch.
I move slowly deeper into the wood.
My steps snap the dead branches.
I climb the trunk to the high branches.
One beat and the fallen leaves scatter.
I go around a dense stand.
I fly toward the noise.
I fly low, but I hit hard.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，从枝下过。
lines.en: I keep low and pass under the branches.

lines.zh: 我停在枝上，大颚微微开合。
lines.en: I perch with my mandibles shifting.

lines.zh: 丛林里很闷，翅膀也不舒服。
lines.en: The jungle is close, and my wings feel it.

lines.zh: 我的壳在光下泛着硬光。
lines.en: My shell holds a hard shine.
I am cutting a length of trunk.
Sawdust falls at my feet.

lines.zh: 有只小鸟从我面前飞走了。
lines.en: A small bird fled past me.
My scissors slowly open.

lines.zh: 我停在枝上，听下面的脚步声。
lines.en: I perch and listen for footsteps below.
My mandibles click shut.

lines.zh: 我把头转过去，看另一边。
lines.en: I turn my head the other way.
I am the largest thing in this wood.

lines.zh: 我把树干推了一下，它晃了。
lines.en: I push the trunk and it rocks.
I wait for a little wind.
I fold my wing membrane under my hard shell.
You are under the tree I am cutting.

lines.zh: 我这两把颚，能咬断木头。
lines.en: These mandibles cut through wood.
You're thinner than one of my legs.
These jaws are for hard shells.

lines.zh: 我不主动找麻烦，只是路过。
lines.en: I don't start trouble. Just passing through.
Do not stand on me.

lines.zh: 我飞起来的时候，风很大。
lines.en: When I take flight the wind is strong.
These big mandibles can hear you.

lines.zh: 我在这一带已经很久了。
lines.en: I have been in this part a long while.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西挡不住我的颚。
lines.en: That will not stop my mandibles.
I bring my great mandibles to your face.

lines.zh: 你要走那条路，得绕开我。
lines.en: To take that path you must go round me.
The bark I cut is already splitting.
Take your foot off that root.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，隔着壳我都听得见。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat right through my shell.
One movement covers that.
A cut has opened in my shell.
I drag my shell behind the roots.
I can still fly with this.
My mandibles close slower now.

lines.zh: 翅膜破了一角，我抖了抖。
lines.en: A corner of my wing membrane is torn; I shake it.

lines.zh: 壳裂处渗出树汁般的东西。
lines.en: Something like sap seeps from the crack in my shell.
I rest on a branch a moment.
I keep that in my shell.
I tuck all six legs under my shell.
I am not cut open yet.
Is that the smell of meat?
My great mandibles dip to peer at it.

lines.zh: 这点东西，比我砍的树小。
lines.en: That is smaller than the trees I cut.
I could crush it in one bite.
This meat smell — one bite and it's crushed.
What you threw, I caught.
Too hard. Not food.
I want more. Bring another.
When done I go back to cutting.
That is not half a meal.
I pick it up and hold it by my jaws.

lines.zh: 这一点比我砍的树少多了。
lines.en: That is far less than the trees I cut.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的壳纹丝不动。
lines.en: You crash into my shell and it doesn't budge.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的壳只响了一声。
lines.en: You hit me; my shell only clicks.
Back off. My mandibles are at the front.

lines.zh: 你踩在我前腿上，壳都震了。
lines.en: You step on my foreleg and my shell jars.
I turn my body to let you pass.

lines.zh: 这一点碰撞，我连翅膀都没动。
lines.en: That did not even stir my wings.

lines.zh: 枝上的叶子被你碰落了。
lines.en: You knocked the leaves down.
I step back and the tree answers.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞在我的颚上，退了。
lines.en: Your shoulder meets my mandible and bounces back.

lines.zh: 退后，我的颚在你脖子边。
lines.en: Back off; my mandibles are at your neck.
There are a few more in this wood.
Each holds its own tree.
One of them stays very high.
The trees I have cut, it has cut too.

lines.zh: 我们在同一片林子里干活。
lines.en: We work the same piece of wood.
Neither crosses the line.
I hear its wingbeats.
That sound is lower than mine.
We never settle together.
The wood is large. It is enough.
I take up a piece of wood in my mandibles.
This one would do for a beam.
I carry it aside.
There is a heap of sawdust on the ground.

lines.zh: 亮的东西我不夹，木头才要紧。
lines.en: I don't pinch shiny things; timber matters.
I pick up a piece of meat and eat it.

lines.zh: 我夹了两下，这木头太沉。
lines.en: Two tries with my mandibles; the timber is too heavy.
I stand it against a tree.
I keep all this timber.
I waste nothing.

lines.zh: 林子里有东西在搬木头。
lines.en: Something in the grove is hauling timber.
I am on the branch above it.

lines.zh: 它在树下砍木头，没抬头。
lines.en: It's chopping wood below and hasn't looked up.

lines.zh: 这个角度，我可以直接落下去。
lines.en: From here I could drop straight down.

lines.zh: 我松开树枝，翅膀张开半寸。
lines.en: I loosen my grip and spread my wings a hand's width.
It reaches the tree.
Slowly I let go of the branch.
It has stopped under the tree.
I click my mandibles once.

lines.zh: 它抬起头来了，钳子也抬了。
lines.en: It looked up. So did the pincers.
Then I drop.
I fold my wings and fall straight.
I follow it through the wood.
It keeps cutting trees.

lines.zh: 我压着树冠，绕到它背后。
lines.en: I skim the canopy and circle behind it.

lines.zh: 它没注意到上面的声音。
lines.en: It did not notice the sound above.
I land on the tree behind it.

lines.zh: 我的影子被树冠挡住了。
lines.en: The canopy hides my shadow.
It turns to carry timber.
One dive covers that.

lines.zh: 我从枝上压下去，等着落点。
lines.en: I sink against the branch, waiting for the drop.
It has come back under the tree.
I wait for it to set the wood down.
It has set the wood down.

lines.zh: 我收翅，从枝头直坠下来。
lines.en: I fold my wings and drop straight from the branch.
My mandibles clamp its shoulder.
It backs away and I follow.
My forelegs pin its chest.
That drives it into a tree.

lines.zh: 它抬脚踢我，我退了半步。
lines.en: It kicks and I give half a step.
I clamp again, harder.
Its bone sounds between my mandibles.
I have lifted it.
And I throw it down.
It rolls once and tries to rise.
I come down on it.

lines.zh: 我从树上落下来，翅膀收着。
lines.en: I drop from the tree with wings folded.
My mandibles are bigger than my head.
This jungle is wet and the wood is soft.
I land and the grass lies flat.
I open my mandibles and close them.
I have chosen a large tree.
The bark on this tree is good to chew.
I climb and test a branch.
Other insects are calling in the wood.
I begin to cut the tree.

lines.zh: 我把这棵树的皮啃开了。
lines.en: I've chewed the bark off this tree.

lines.zh: 我抬头找一根够粗的枝。
lines.en: I look up for a branch thick enough.
Wind passes between the trunks.

lines.zh: 我收翅落稳，把身体压低。
lines.en: I fold my wings, land, and lower my bulk.

lines.zh: 火一碰翅膜，我就往下坠。
lines.en: Fire touches my wing membrane and I drop.

lines.zh: 树枝断了，我砸进落叶里。
lines.en: The branch broke and I hit the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的壳缝，我下沉。
lines.en: Water enters my shell joints and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆响把我从枝上掀下来。
lines.en: The blast tore me off the branch.
An arrow stands in my back.

lines.zh: 一道怪力把我的腿钉在地上。
lines.en: A strange force pins my legs to the ground.

lines.zh: 这片林子已经没有软木头了。
lines.en: There is no soft wood left in this wood.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，壳都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my shell lit up.

lines.zh: 脚下的枝没了，我在坠落。
lines.en: The branch below is gone and I am falling.
